listings.name: Casa Masi
listings.remark: Set in the peaceful Tuscan countryside just outside Montaione, Casa Masi is one of the area’s best-known restaurants, offering refined traditional Tuscan cuisine in an elegant country-house setting. Seasonal local ingredients, homemade specialties and an outstanding wine list make it an excellent choice for both special occasions and relaxed dinners. Reservations are strongly recommended, especially during weekends and the summer season.

listings.name: La Locanda del Gobbo Nero
listings.remark: Opening Hours: Mon, Tue, Thu & Fri 19:00–22:00 · Sat 19:00–22:00 · Sun 12:00–14:30 & 19:00–22:00 · Closed Wed. Agriturismo restaurant at Tenuta Moriniello, offering refined Tuscan cuisine, estate-produced organic wines and olive oil, and panoramic vineyard views. Ideal for a special lunch or dinner.

listings.name: Osteria del Castagno
listings.address: Via Camporbiano 1/4, 50050 Il Castagno, Gambassi Terme (FI)
listings.remark: Traditional Tuscan cuisine with homemade specialties, an excellent wine selection, and a charming terrace. Ideal for both lunch and dinner in a relaxed countryside setting. Opening Hours: Thu–Mon 07:00–22:00 (closed Tue & Wed)

listings.name: Antico Pastificio Morelli / Ristorante Mo
listings.remark: Gluten free pasta and “normal” pasta – very delicious! Close to Pontedera They do have a small restaurant with tasty pasta dishes

listings.name: Monte Bernardi
listings.remark: Very good wines in Chianti, only red wines. Oﬀer various Chianti Classicos as well as a kind of Bordeaux grape blend. Beautiful seating outside, need to call before the visit. It is very close to the restaurant “Le Panzanelle” – it’s on the list

listings.name: Nittardi
listings.remark: Very good winery with great white and red wines. Wonderful location, full of art and sculptures. Unique place to go. They do speak several languages

listings.name: Giovanni Chiappini Winery
listings.remark: Chiappini is locoted next to Orma, Ornelliaia etc. Producer of excellent wines, in the meantime also well known since he got some years ago very high scores for his Bolgheri Superiore Guado dei Gemoli. Very good white wines and red wines. They have introduced a fee for tasting, but we never needed to pay either because Giovanni (70+ years old) passed by or we have purchased a reasonable amount of cases

listings.name: Dario di Vaira
listings.remark: Very small winery in Bolgheri; Dario has taken over the vineyard from his father some years ago and produces high quality white and red wines, reasonable pricing. He oﬀers for white a Vermentino and a Viognier, for red a Bolgheri rosso and Bolgheri Superiore. In particular the Bolgheri Superiore has a light mint taste, very good. You need to call them upfront to your visit

listings.name: Tenuta Sant’Ilario
listings.address: Loc. Cabbialla Strada Proivinziale 4 Volterrana 127 50050 Gambassi Terme (FI)
listings.remark: Very nice agriturismo type location with a pretty good restaurant, typical Tuscany food al terra, nice place for summer and also winter times. They do speak several languages

listings.name: I Collazzi
listings.remark: Very beautiful location outside of Florence. This is a winery and restaurant. Very good wines, very good food. You need to book a table in restaurant, since they do not open every day and have many events like weddings etc.

listings.name: Le Panzanelle
listings.remark: Very nice garden in summer, very local food and excellent wine list; restaurant gets run by three women. Many Italians go there. Medium pricing, good place for lunch during a visit to wineries in Chianti

listings.name: All’Olivo
listings.remark: Very nice place to sit outside in Lucca, upper level, good for fish and also meat.

listings.name: La Foresta
listings.remark: Fish place directly at the sea and beach, oﬀera basically food al mare. Food of high quality. Beautiful terrace

listings.name: Lo Scoglietto
listings.address: Via Lungomare Monte alla Rena 13-15 57016 Rossignano Marittima
listings.remark: Located directly at the sea and beach, this is a wonderful place on sunny days. Place to eat al mare. Usually very busy, in particular in summer. Easy place, medium pricing, always very good food

listings.name: Maggese
listings.remark: Maggese is one of Tuscany’s most innovative restaurants, led by renowned chef Fabrizio Marino. Celebrated for its exceptional vegetarian and vegan cuisine, it also offers selected non-vegetarian dishes, making it an outstanding choice for every guest. Just a short drive from Castelfalfi, Maggese delivers a unique fine dining experience based on seasonal local ingredients. https://www.ristorantemaggese.it/

listings.name: Osteria del Sole
listings.remark: Sunday: Closed A charming family-run restaurant led by a young and welcoming team, with the parents actively involved in the kitchen. Enjoy authentic Tuscan cuisine, excellent wood-fired pizzas, and consistently high-quality regional dishes. The carefully selected local wines are offered at very reasonable prices, making it outstanding value for money.

listings.name: Pasticceria Ferretti
listings.remark: A long-established family-run restaurant and pastry shop in the heart of Peccioli, celebrated for its authentic Tuscan cuisine and handcrafted desserts. Chef Andrea Donati focuses on seasonal ingredients sourced from local producers, creating refined yet traditional dishes. The warm atmosphere, excellent pastries and outstanding value have made Ferretti one of the area’s most highly regarded dining destinations. Monday closed.

listings.name: I’Ciampa
listings.remark: A welcoming family-run restaurant in the historic centre of Montaione, serving authentic Tuscan cuisine alongside a wide selection of pizzas. Guests can dine on the panoramic terrace or in the peaceful garden while enjoying regional wines, including labels from the family’s own winery. Friendly service, generous portions and excellent value make I’ Ciampa a favourite with both locals and visitors.

listings.name: Chiarò
listings.remark: Chiarò is an elegant seafood restaurant run by the former team of the well-known La Terrazza in Montaione. Specializing in fresh fish, Mediterranean cuisine and an excellent wine selection, it offers refined dining in a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Located just a short drive from Castelfalfi, it has quickly become one of the region’s top destinations for seafood lovers. Monday closed.

listings.name: Oscar
listings.remark: One of the best places for fish; located in the middle of a living area, there are more beautiful places to sit, but the food is excellent. Oscar is always full of Italians, not many foreigners go here to eat

listings.name: La Ripadoro Agri Ristorante
listings.remark: www.Laripadoro.it A beautiful place on top of the hill, beautiful terrace with good view. Very good food, mostly al terra, run by a family; they offer very local wines

listings.name: Osteria L’Upupa (in San Mineato)
listings.remark: www.ristorantelupupa.com

listings.name: Papeveri & Papere (in San Miniato)
listings.remark: www.papaveriepaolo.com; hey offer a la carte and a fixed menu al mare or al terra for ca. 60€ (4-5 courses); Daniele was the best Sommelier of Tuscany in 2023; he offers very good wines for very reasonable prices

listings.name: Tenuta di Biserno
listings.remark: Born into the lineage of Ludovico Antinori, the brilliant mind behind Ornellaia.

listings.name: Wintasting Tamburini
listings.address: 50050 Gambassi Terme, via Catagnano,106, LOC il. Castellucco
listings.remark: Wonderful afternoon in a familiar atmosphere with beautiful wine and canapés

listings.name: Enrico Salvini
listings.remark: Very Good Bakery, Wonderful Focaccia and homemade Cookies

listings.name: Maurits van Heyst VAN HEYST ESCAPES
listings.address: Private Consultations in Castelfalfi Borgo (by appointment)
listings.remark: Independent luxury real estate advisor specialising in Italy and Tuscany. Drawing on his long-standing connection to Castelfalfi, in-depth market expertise and international network, he supports owners and international buyers with property sales, acquisitions, valuations and comprehensive transaction advice.

listings.name: Rosa Canina Team
listings.remark: Toelettatura Rosa Canina is a professional dog grooming salon in Selvatelle, offering caring and experienced grooming services for dogs of all breeds and sizes. Services typically include bathing, brushing, clipping and breed-specific styling, with a strong focus on the comfort and wellbeing of every dog.

listings.name: Real Garden (Salvatore & Raffaele)
listings.remark: Garden design, landscaping, irrigation systems, fencing, tree pruning, garden maintenance and outdoor living solutions. They are known for reliable workmanship, professional service and an excellent understanding of the local environment, making them a trusted choice for property owners in the Castelfalfi area.

listings.name: Christian Todarisca – Elettro T.C.
listings.remark: A highly experienced local contractor specializing in air conditioning, heating systems, electrical installations and general building services. Christian knows Castelfalfi exceptionally well and has completed projects for many Borgo owners as well as several villa owners. He is widely regarded as one of the area’s most knowledgeable technicians and is particularly recommended for HVAC installations, maintenance and troubleshooting, as well as electrical work. Due to high demand, scheduling may require some advance planning.

listings.name: Riccardo Elefante
listings.remark: Experienced local carpenter specialising in bespoke woodwork, custom furniture, doors, windows and interior fittings. Offers repairs, maintenance and tailor-made woodworking solutions for residential properties. A reliable local craftsman for both small repairs and larger carpentry projects in and around Montaione.

listings.name: Fontanelli Pneumatici Srl
listings.remark: Professional tyre services, seasonal tyre changes, tyre repairs, tyre storage, wheel balancing, vehicle servicing, brakes, batteries, suspension, air conditioning and routine maintenance.

listings.name: AMP S.R.L.
listings.remark: A specialist workshop for the restoration and refurbishment of classic car interiors, offering bespoke upholstery in leather and fabric, convertible tops, carpets, headliners, and interior trim. Combining traditional craftsmanship with mechanical expertise, AMP also undertakes selected restoration work on historic vehicles.

listings.name: Noi2 Tendaggi
listings.remark: A local specialist in high-quality sun protection and outdoor living solutions, offering custom-made awnings, ZIP screens, pergolas, insect screens, and shading systems for residential and commercial properties. The company provides consultation, installation, and after-sales service, focusing on quality materials and tailored solutions. Payment Information: The company trades as Noi2 Tendaggi. The legal entity for bank transfers is IL SEMAFORO DI CECCONI FRANCO E LAPENNA SIMONA S.N.C.

listings.name: Sarandria Francesco Infissi
listings.address: Via delle Colline per Legoli 3/A 56025 Pontedera (PI), Tuscany, Italy
listings.remark: Professional services & repairs of high-quality windows, doors, shutters, and insect screens. They provide custom-made solutions for residential and commercial properties, combining professional craftsmanship with reliable installation and after-sales service.

listings.name: Giacomo Pistolesi Picchio Reale Project
listings.remark: Giacomo is a friendly, approachable craftsman who specializes in the custom manufacture and repair of doors, windows, furniture, and other wooden items. He offers good value for money and delivers quality workmanship. However, working with him does require a little patience. If you have an urgent project, he may not be the best choice.

listings.name: Rentokil Initial Italia SpA
listings.remark: www.rentokil.com/it/

listings.name: TERMAK
listings.address: Via Luigi Capuana snc 56028 San Miniato (PI)
listings.remark: www.termak.it The company has also carried out many of the heating and plumbing installations in Castelfalfi on behalf of TDC and is therefore familiar with the systems and infrastructure.

listings.name: IN GIARDINO SRL
listings.remark: The company offers permanently installed and portable mosquito control systems for gardens and balconies. www.ingiardinoweb.it www.impiantoantizanzare.it www.freezanz.it

listings.name: Ninci Elettrodomestici srl
listings.address: Via 2 Giugno 5 loc.Ponte a Elsa Empoli
listings.remark: www.ninci.it

listings.name: Montaione Giardini Srl
listings.remark: General gardening services

listings.name: Edward D’Costa
listings.remark: Edward D’Costa offers private, tailor-made wellness experiences designed to help clients relax, recharge, and improve their physical and mental well-being. His services include personal training, Hatha yoga for beginners, stretching, meditation, brain kinetics, and bodyweight training. Sessions are individually adapted to each client’s fitness level and goals and can be held directly at your accommodation, allowing you to enjoy a convenient and personalized wellness experience in the beautiful surroundings of Castelfalfi and the Tuscan countryside.

listings.name: Romina Vargiu
listings.address: MiniHospital Capanoli, Via Antonio Gramsci, 29, 56033 Capannoli
listings.remark: Romina Vargiu has more than 20 years of experience in physiotherapy and rehabilitation. In addition to treating musculoskeletal conditions, she has particular expertise in respiratory and cardiological rehabilitation and has participated in numerous clinical research studies. She offers a wide range of modern physiotherapy treatments, including Tecar Therapy, shockwave therapy and lymphatic drainage.

listings.name: Farmacia Viotti
listings.remark: Opening hours: Monday – Saturday: 8.30 – 20:00 Medication requests and prescription pre-orders can be conveniently submitted via WhatsApp at +39 347 061 6748.

listings.name: Oculista – Dott. Vincenzo Parducci
listings.remark: Mon–Fri 09:00–19:00 · Sat 09:00–12:30 · Closed Sun. Remark: Highly experienced ophthalmologist specializing in cataract, glaucoma, retinal diseases, laser treatments, and comprehensive eye care.

listings.name: Radius Valdelsa (Castelfiorentino)
listings.remark: Radius Valdelsa is a medical diagnostic center, wich offers radiological examinations as well as various outpatient specialist services. The facility uses modern medical technology and a team of specialists for diagnosis and patient care. Online booking is possible!

listings.name: Dott. Vincenzo Parducci
listings.remark: Highly experienced ophthalmologist with many years of hospital and surgical expertise. Specialised in cataract surgery, glaucoma treatment, retinal diseases and comprehensive eye examinations. Provides modern diagnostics, preventive eye care and long-term follow-up treatment. A trusted specialist for routine eye care as well as complex ophthalmic conditions.

listings.name: Farmacia Priamo
listings.remark: Opening Hours: Mon–Sat: 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, 4:30 PM–8:00 PM Sun: Closed

listings.name: UP!Estetica
listings.remark: Manicures, pedicures and beauty treatments. They’re very busy. You should make an appointment well in advance.

listings.name: Studio Odontoiatrico D´ Arienzo
listings.remark: A modern dental clinic in Montaione, offering general dentistry and cosmetic dental treatments. The clinic is known for its personalized patient care and high patient satisfaction. Appointments in Montaione are available on Tuesday and Friday afternoons.

listings.name: Studio Dentistico Pantani Dott. Ivano
listings.remark: General dental practice offering preventive, restorative and routine dental treatments for adults and children.

listings.name: Dr. Vito Lacerenza
listings.remark: Experienced dentist providing comprehensive dental care, including routine examinations, preventive treatments and restorative dentistry for patients of all ages.

listings.remark: General practitioner offering primary healthcare, preventive medicine and ongoing medical care for residents and visitors.

listings.name: Dr.ssa Elena Simoni
listings.remark: General practitioner providing comprehensive primary healthcare, preventive medicine and medical assistance for residents and visitors.

listings.name: Dr. Francesco Lotti
listings.remark: Emergency service: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. He is specialized in the treatment of small animals such as dogs and cats. His main areas of expertise include internal medicine, diagnostics and the treatment of vetenery diseases.

listings.name: Ambulatorio Veterinario, Associato Dott. Fantoni – Dott .ssa Iacolina
listings.remark: This clinic provides comprehensive medical care for small animals such as dogs and cats. Services include preventive care, diagnostics and treatment of both acute and chronic conditions.

listings.name: AniCura Veterinary Clinic Cascina
listings.address: Via Tosco Romagnola Ovest 338, 56012 Fornacette (Calcinaia), Pisa, Italy
listings.remark: AniCura Veterinary Clinic Cascina is a full-service veterinary referral and emergency hospital located just beyond Pontedera, in Fornacette (Calcinaia). The clinic provides both routine and specialist veterinary care, including surgery, diagnostic imaging, internal medicine, neurology, orthopaedics, intensive care and a 24-hour emergency service, 365 days a year.

listings.name: Medical Emergency
listings.remark: In the event of a serious medical emergency, you can always call 112 or 118 directly. 112 is the standardized European emergency number, while 118 is the traditional Italian emergency medical number, which remains active and operational.

listings.name: Ospedale Castelfiorentino
listings.remark: The hospital is a local healthcare facility in Tuscany. It provides outpatient services,emergency care and basic diagnistic procedures. For specialized treatments, patients are referred to larger hospitals in the regionn

listings.name: University Hospital Ospedale Cisanello
listings.remark: One of Tuscany’s leading university hospitals, offering highly specialized medical care across virtually all disciplines. Renowned for its advanced diagnostics, expert physicians, and state-of-the-art treatment facilities. A trusted referral center for complex medical conditions.

listings.name: Birga Parrucchieri
listings.remark: A long-established, modern and highly popular hair salon in Pontedera, with convenient parking directly in front of the premises and very reasonable local pricing.

listings.name: Dott.ssa Silvia Babboni
listings.remark: Dott.ssa Babboni runs a dental practice offering modern dental care and treatments. Her services include preventive care, restorative dentistry and aesthetic dental treatments. Lunedì, mercoledì, giovedì, venerdì 09:00 – 19:30 Chiuso martedì, sabato e domenica

listings.name: Expert City – Rossi
listings.remark: A reliable local retailer for household appliances, consumer electronics, TVs, computers and small electrical equipment. Particularly recommended for APIC members thanks to their friendly and knowledgeable staff, as well as their dependable delivery and professional installation service. An excellent choice for purchasing and replacing household appliances in the Montaione and Castelfalfi area.

listings.name: Antico Pastificio Morelli / Ristorante Mo
listings.remark: Gluten free pasta and “normal” pasta – very delicious! Close to Pontedera They do have a small restaurant with tasty pasta dishes

listings.name: Multicolor
listings.remark: You get everything what you need for the house and garden. They are super helpful if you have to fix something.

listings.name: Chelotti Roasting
listings.address: Via Primo Maggio, 281, 51010 Margine Coperta-Traversagna PT
listings.remark: One of Tuscany’s best-known artisan coffee roasters, famous for its traditional wood-roasting method. The historic roastery is located in Buggiano (Via Benedetto Croce 20), while the modern café and specialty coffee shop are nearby in Margine Coperta (Via Primo Maggio 281), north of Lucca. Although it is a bit of a drive from Castelfalfi, coffee lovers will find the visit well worth the journey.

listings.name: Zooing Terricciola
listings.address: Via Salaiola Sud 68, 56030 La Rosa di Terricciola (PI)
listings.remark: Large pet and garden centre offering premium pet food and accessories for dogs, cats, birds, rodents and fish, together with gardening supplies, agricultural products, hardware, household goods and pet grooming services. Conveniently located in La Rosa, between Peccioli and Terricciola. Hours Mon–Sat: 9:00–13:00 & 15:30–19:30 Sun: Closed

listings.remark: A health food store offering a wide range of organic products, conveniently located and easily accessible, with free customer parking available directly in front of the store. The store is located on the outskirts of town and is only five minutes away from the large Coop shopping center in Empoli. Orders can be placed in advance via WhatsApp. Product-related questions can also be answered through this channel.
